voice.openHint: Rinda reads every question aloud and listens to your answer. You can still tap at any time.
voice.title: Voice check-up
voice.notice: Rinda speaks the questions and listens through your browser. Your browser’s speech service (Google or Apple) turns your voice into text. Rinda does not record or keep your voice.
voice.englishOnly: The voice check-up is in English for now.
voice.noMic: This browser cannot listen. You can still hear each question and tap your answer.
voice.waiting: Tap an answer, or press Answer by voice.
voice.tapOnly: Please tap your answer for this question.
voice.done: Every question has been asked. Send now, or stop to check your answers on the form.
